errors.evidence: The bars in the figure are grouped, not stacked. The reference description does not mention stacking, and the image clearly shows separate bars for each category (Bund, Länder, Gemeinden) aligned side-by-side for each year.

The reference description states a decline to about 2.5% by 2000, and the image shows the lowest point of the black line (Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt) in the left diagram is closer to 2.3-2.4%, not 2.2%.

The reference description states the final value is just under 3%, and the image shows the black line in the left diagram ending closer to 2.7-2.8%, but the machine-generated description slightly understates the final trend.

The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the left diagram shows 'Bruttoanlageinvestitionen' (gross fixed capital formation) and the right diagram shows 'Nettoanlageinvestitionen' (net fixed capital formation), which is clearly mentioned in the reference description.

The reference description mentions that the net investments (right diagram) fall into the negative range and later fluctuate around zero, but the machine-generated description does not explicitly highlight the negative values of the 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt' line, which briefly dips below zero around 2005.
The reference description notes that net investments (right diagram) never exceed 0.6% after 2015, but the machine-generated description does not mention this specific cap.
